headline: Central Bank of Nigeria Records N3.20 Trillion Net Liquidity Injection in October
summary: The Central Bank of Nigeria recorded a net liquidity injection of approximately N3.20 trillion in October 2026 as debt repayments outpaced auctions.
why: Central bank liquidity operations influence short-term interbank interest rates and overall banking sector liquidity, which are critical for monetary policy transmission and bank lending capacity.

impacts.name: Nigeria
impacts.why: The net liquidity injection by the central bank directly impacts domestic banking system liquidity and monetary conditions in Nigeria.
